## Professional Summary
Ahmed Aqeel (DevAhmedAqeel) is a senior AI-powered Full Stack Developer, Cross-Platform Mobile App Engineer, Graphic & Logo Designer, and the Founder of DevOrbit Tech (https://devorbittech.org/). He builds scalable web applications, iOS and Android mobile apps (React Native & Flutter), custom vector logos and brand identity kits, automated n8n AI agent workflows, and Python web scrapers for global founders, startups, and enterprises.

## Global Services & Offerings

### 1. Full Stack Web Development (React / Next.js / Node.js)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Next.js 14/15, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
- **Projects**: Custom SaaS applications, e-commerce web stores, client portals, real-time dashboards, and REST/GraphQL APIs.
- **Delivery**: 100% responsive, SEO-optimized, accessible, with CI/CD deployment on Vercel, AWS, or DigitalOcean.

### 2. Cross-Platform Mobile App Development (React Native & Flutter)
- **Tech Stack**: React Native, Flutter, Expo, Dart, iOS App Store & Android Google Play Store builds.
- **Projects**: Real-time chat & social apps, healthcare AI diagnostics (e.g. Medireport AI), booking platforms, offline-first apps with Firebase/Supabase.
- **Delivery**: High 60fps animations, biometric authentication, push notifications, and store deployment.

### 3. Graphic Designing, Brand Identity & Custom Logo Design
- **Tech Stack**: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, UI/UX Wireframing, Vector Systems.
- **Projects**: Premium custom vector logos, complete brand guidelines (colors, typography, assets), social media kits, and pixel-perfect Figma UI/UX designs.

### 4. AI Agents & n8n Autonomous Workflow Automation
- **Tech Stack**: n8n, Ollama, Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI GPT-4o, LangChain, Webhooks, REST APIs.
- **Projects**: Autonomous customer support AI chatbots, CRM lead enrichment, automated invoice processing, multi-channel notifications.

### 5. Python Automation & Enterprise Web Scraping
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3, Selenium, Playwright, Beautiful Soup, Pandas, Cron automation.
- **Projects**: Scheduled headless data extraction, real-time price monitoring bots, data cleaning, automated PDF/Excel reports.

### 6. Cloud Database & Backend Infrastructure
- **Tech Stack**: Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Auth), Supabase (PostgreSQL, Realtime, RLS), Redis.
- **Projects**: Scalable serverless backends, secure multi-tenant architectures, real-time data sync.
